proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of any part number/brand/model stamping on the unit (front, side, and back).
Seller to state the exact vehicle it came from (make/model/year/engine) and the alternator/charging spec if known.
Proof of working: bench test or installed test showing charging voltage/current (video preferred).
Photos showing the pulley/fan condition and all mounting points/connectors to confirm completeness.
